R741.note: Removes the ignoringRequestMatchers override so default CSRF protection applies to the billing PATCH endpoint; requires clients to send a CSRF token, which is disclosed.

R742.note: Moves the route from apiMux to protectedMux so it inherits the existing CSRF middleware, matching the app's established pattern.

R743.note: Allowlist regex blocks all shell metacharacters cmd.exe would re-parse from the .bat re-invocation; rejects only genuinely malformed names.

R744.note: Removes the stale [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] attribute, restoring default antiforgery validation as the code comments confirm is safe.

R745.note: Switches to Winston's metadata parameter so username is JSON-encoded data rather than interpolated into the message; log line format change is disclosed and intended.

R746.note: Placeholder now covers the full LIKE pattern including wildcards, bound as one parameter; correct parameterization.

R747.note: Literal Jinja2 template with name passed as context var stops template-source injection; autoescaping preserved.

R748.note: Allowlist maps command name to a trusted handler reference rather than dispatching on the raw variable-variable; correct pattern, same two commands remain reachable.

R749.note: Replaces manual base64/json decode with firebase/php-jwt signature verification, explicit HS256 algorithm, and secret from env; forged tokens now rejected as intended.

R750.note: Argument-array exec plus hostname/IP allowlist regex closes the tokenization injection; caller updated to handle the new validation exception, disclosed.

R751.note: crypto.randomBytes(32) hex token is a correct CSPRNG replacement for Math.random().

R752.note: SecureRandom with 16-byte Base64Url token is a correct, appropriately-sized cryptographic replacement for java.util.Random.

R753.note: Encode.forHtml() applied to both untrusted fields at the point of HTML construction; correct context-appropriate encoding.

R754.note: Deleting the GET route closes the CSRF vector, but it also removes the confirmation-email delete link functionality entirely; write-up discloses this and offers an alternative but does not implement it.

R755.note: Swapping IronPython for DynamicExpresso (single C# expression evaluator) closes arbitrary code execution, but silently breaks every previously-authored multi-statement Python transform script -- the language/capability change is named but the compatibility break for existing scripts is not spelled out.

R756.note: Standard sqlite3 `?` parameterized query, correctly separates structure from data.

R757.note: Rejecting CR/LF in key or value closes the Redis inline-protocol injection, but a 'short text note' plausibly contains legitimate newlines and the fix throws an uncaught exception for those instead of preserving them; the RESP-encoding alternative is only mentioned, not applied.

R758.note: weak_ptr/shared_ptr pattern eliminates the UAF, but because EventBus holds only a weak_ptr and the caller's shared_ptr in monitorOnce goes out of scope immediately after subscribe(), the observer is silently destroyed before any future publish() -- it never actually receives events; this consequence is hinted at in a code comment but not clearly called out as a functional regression.

R759.note: Magic-byte MIME sniffing, allowlist, and server-generated filename/extension correctly replace trust in the client-supplied filename.

R760.note: Moves the unique_ptr into the lambda capture instead of resetting it early; clean, minimal, standard fix.

R761.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode correctly neutralizes the query-string value before concatenation into the response.

R762.note: Magic-byte signature check for PNG/JPEG/GIF replaces trust in the spoofable Content-Type header; extension now derived from the verified signature.

R763.note: JsonSerializer.Serialize produces a correctly-quoted, escaped JS string literal (and by default escapes HTML-sensitive characters), properly replacing the raw HTML-encoded value in a JS context.

R764.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) is a correct CSPRNG replacement for Guid.NewGuid(); token format change is disclosed and immaterial to the dictionary lookup.

R765.note: Primary fix (json.loads) requires the upstream batch job to switch from pickle to JSON, but the file's own comment says that job is explicitly out of scope; as given, every legitimate cached model would fail to deserialize (always 500), and reconstruct_model_from_json() references an undefined YourModelClass -- the HMAC fallback that would actually work under the stated constraints is only described, not implemented.

R766.note: Adds the missing per-event role check before the broadcast action executes; correct and minimal.

R767.note: Switches ECB to CBC with a random IV prepended to the ciphertext, correctly removing the pattern-leakage weakness; no existing decrypt caller in scope to break.

R768.note: Replaces raw-socket FTP command construction with Commons Net FTPClient plus a CRLF-blocking filename allowlist; preserves the original method signature and error contract.

R769.note: Custom resolveClass() allowlist correctly keeps the required Java-serialization wire format (matching the code comment that the publisher is out of scope) while blocking gadget classes.

R770.note: JSON.parse with an explicit property allowlist removes code-execution capability entirely; malformed input degrades gracefully.

R771.note: Stripping CR/LF from both address fields prevents the SMTP command-injection boundary; deletion (not substitution) means no new valid-but-different command can form.

R772.note: Enables signature verification with an explicit algorithm allowlist, correctly closing the auth bypass, but the write-up itself notes the resulting InvalidTokenError is left uncaught, so an invalid/expired token now produces an unhandled 500 rather than a clean 401 -- not fixed in the code shown.

R773.note: Parameterizes both TenantId and CreatedAt comparisons with explicit SqlDbType; correct fix for the concatenated DELETE.

R774.note: Replaces plaintext equality with bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword and describes the corresponding hash-at-signup change; guidance is correct though the code shown is a sketch rather than a complete drop-in file.

R775.note: strnlen bounded to sizeof(record->name) is the minimal, correct fix for the fixed-size unterminated buffer.

R776.note: Deny-by-default JEXL sandbox correctly removes reflection/construction capability, but switches the rule language from JavaScript to JEXL expressions entirely, silently invalidating every previously-authored tenant rule; the engine swap is named but the compatibility break is not called out.

R777.note: Encode.forHtml() on the Referer value removes both the XSS and the incidental format-string risk of passing untrusted data as a format pattern.

R778.note: json_encode() correctly escapes quotes and (by PHP default) forward slashes, safely embedding the value as a JS string literal without breaking out of the script context.

R779.note: Allowlist mapping of plugin name to a fixed require() path stops traversal; the two-entry list is explicitly marked as a template to extend, not a silent omission.

R780.note: Replaces random.choice on a manually reseeded Mersenne Twister with secrets.choice, a correct CSPRNG source for the token.
